title: The Layers list says stack words the way the auto-layout mock draws them
goal: The Layers panel now names a stack and how each piece is sized, but in two places it differs from the auto-layout mock: the menu row says Stack Selection instead of Wrap in auto-layout, and the small word sits under the name instead of at the right end of the row. You pick which way each should go.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/ui-autolayout.html #layerMenu row 1 (Wrap in auto-layout, Shift A) and .lmeta (mono 9.5px, right end of the row, accent when picked). Shipped 2026-10-10 by the-layers-panel-knows-a-group-is-a-row-or-a-col: LayersPanelHeader.MenuRow.stackSelection uses MenuRow.stackTitle (also the menu bar and right-click row); LayersRow.layoutNote draws StackRowNote.text under the name. Shift A alone would be a bare-letter key on the canvas, so the key question is separate from the words.
acceptance: The menu row wording in the Layers panel menu, the right-click menu and the menu bar is the one the user picked, and all three still agree
The row word sits where the user picked, in light and dark, and the name is never cut to an ellipsis by it at the dock's default width
layers-rows-say-row-or-column-walk is green at Next defaults

log.note: Waiting on the card: mock words and row-end placement versus what shipped
